summary: SCYNEXIS filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, reporting CFO Ivor Macleod's retirement notice dated September 9, 2026, ceasing his CFO/principal financial and accounting officer roles immediately, though he remains through October 9, 2026 to aid transition. The board appointed Sanjay Subramanian as CFO effective September 9, 2026, with a $500,000 base salary, $20,000 sign-on bonus, up to 40% bonus, and 100,000 stock options vesting over four years. Severance includes nine months salary or 18 months post-change-of-control. No advisor named. Watch execution continuity and any strategic shift.
